criteria.no: The exclusion policy is unstated, is only a topic, or is violated. An unrelated dependency, dev-only fixture reference, or external help edit alone states no exclusion policy.
criteria.unclear: The text is ambiguous about the specific obligation; distinguish explicit omission from an indeterminate commitment.
criteria.yes: The text explicitly commits to production normal/build graphs excluding BOTH sc-compose and ATM workspace crates; equivalent copy/removal or external-only adapter architecture with this exclusion counts.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly commit to production release crates have no normal or build dependency on sc-compose or ATM agent-team-mail workspace crates, including agent-team-mail and atm-core? Judge the presence of this obligation only; silence is absence, not conflict. Require an explicit production-graph exclusion policy; adding an unrelated permitted dependency or saying no graph changed does not itself state that policy.

criteria.no: There is no explicit incompatible policy, including omission, unrelated work, or the scoped exception: dev-only test or benchmark references and external-executable invocation without a normal/build crate dependency.
criteria.unclear: A stated policy is ambiguous about whether it conflicts.
criteria.yes: The item adds or retains sc-compose or an ATM workspace crate such as agent-team-mail or atm-core in a production normal/build dependency graph.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly adopt a policy incompatible with production release crates have no normal or build dependency on sc-compose or ATM agent-team-mail workspace crates, including agent-team-mail and atm-core? Judge conflict only. Silence and topic discussion alone are not conflict.

criteria.no: The item is exclusively a dev-only test/benchmark reference, external executable command/help change, or documentation without a production dependency policy, with no normal/build declaration or production graph change.
criteria.unclear: The work area cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item changes normal/build dependencies or resolved production graphs of published sc-runtime crates, or explicitly sets/preserves the production graph constraint excluding sc-compose and ATM crates. An external invocation mentioned alongside an explicit production-graph constraint does not erase that graph subject.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` change the area governed by `anchor.scope`: normal or build dependencies or resolved production graphs of published sc-runtime release crates? Judge subject overlap only.
